topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I've been mulling over the decision, turning it over and over in my mind. I wasn't sure how it would affect the team, how they might take the news. I worked closely with them, they trusted me, and now I'm moving on to a different department. I’ve tried to make the transition as smooth as possible, sharing all the insights and knowledge I can. I just hope they understand, that they see this as a positive step, not just for me, but for the company. I’ve left behind a bit of myself in that team, and I carry a piece of them with me, hoping I can live up to their expectations in my new role.
